items.prompt: A child's room at dusk. A small girl in pyjamas, seen from behind, kneels on a windowsill cushion watching a grey cat leap at a fly. The fly trails a faint trail of silver dust in the air. Far below in the window, a car's headlights approach. A single impossibly thin luminous thread rises vertically through the room toward the ceiling.

alt.ru: Детская в сумерках: девочка в пижаме спиной к нам смотрит, как серый кот прыгает за мухой, за мухой тянется серебряная пыль, через комнату вверх уходит тонкая светящаяся нить.
alt.en: A child's room at dusk: a girl in pyjamas, back to us, watches a grey cat leap at a fly trailing silver dust, a thin glowing thread rising through the room.
alt.pt: Um quarto de criança ao anoitecer: uma menina de pijama, de costas, vê um gato cinzento saltar atrás de uma mosca que deixa pó prateado; um fio fino e luminoso sobe pelo quarto.
alt.es: Un cuarto infantil al anochecer: una niña en pijama, de espaldas, mira cómo un gato gris salta tras una mosca que deja polvo plateado; un hilo fino y luminoso sube por la habitación.

items.prompt: Moscow's Third Ring Road at rush hour in the near future, seen from an overpass: where a traffic jam should be, the cars flow freely in long smooth light trails, lanes almost empty. Apartment towers glow on both sides. Long exposure, calm and slightly uncanny.

alt.ru: Третье кольцо в час пик с эстакады: вместо пробки машины свободно текут длинными световыми следами, полосы почти пустые.
alt.en: The Third Ring Road at rush hour from an overpass: instead of a jam, cars flow freely in long light trails, the lanes almost empty.
alt.pt: O Terceiro Anel de Moscovo na hora de ponta visto de um viaduto: em vez de engarrafamento, os carros fluem em longos rastos de luz, as faixas quase vazias.
alt.es: El Tercer Anillo de Moscú en hora punta desde un paso elevado: en lugar de atasco, los coches fluyen en largas estelas de luz, los carriles casi vacíos.

alt.ru: Сетчатая стальная башня из нескольких ярусов зимой, над заснеженными деревьями и крышами.
alt.en: A lattice steel tower of several tiers in winter, above snowy trees and rooftops.
alt.pt: Uma torre de aço em treliça com vários níveis, no inverno, acima de árvores e telhados com neve.
alt.es: Una torre de acero en celosía de varios tramos en invierno, sobre árboles y tejados nevados.

caption.ru: Шуховская башня на Шаболовке, февраль 2014 года. Инженер Владимир Шухов, 1920–1922.
caption.en: The Shukhov Tower on Shabolovka, February 2014. Engineer Vladimir Shukhov, 1920–1922.
caption.pt: A torre Chukhov em Chabolovka, fevereiro de 2014. Engenheiro Vladimir Chukhov, 1920–1922.
caption.es: La torre Shújov en Shabolovka, febrero de 2014. Ingeniero Vladímir Shújov, 1920–1922.

items.prompt: The open front door of a Moscow apartment, seen from a dim stairwell landing. On the threshold a small child sits cross-legged with a notebook, a grey cat stretched out beside her, seen from a distance with her head bowed over the notebook. Warm kitchen light spills from the flat behind her; the stairwell in front is cold and dark. The feeling of someone who has been waiting.

alt.ru: Открытая дверь квартиры из полутёмного подъезда: на пороге скрестив ноги сидит девочка с блокнотом, рядом растянулся серый кот, за ней тёплый свет кухни.
alt.en: An open flat door seen from a dim stairwell: a girl sits cross-legged on the threshold with a notebook, a grey cat stretched beside her, warm kitchen light behind.
alt.pt: A porta aberta de um apartamento vista de uma escada escura: no limiar, uma menina de pernas cruzadas com um caderno, um gato cinzento estendido ao lado, luz quente da cozinha atrás.
alt.es: La puerta abierta de un piso vista desde una escalera en penumbra: en el umbral, una niña con las piernas cruzadas y un cuaderno, un gato gris tumbado a su lado, luz cálida de cocina detrás.
